captions_note: the big words are the caption for those words: hide the reel's captions for this span
steps: run onsets.py      # 2. word frames from the audio (check words.json: Whisper can mishear or invent a line)
run scene.py measure      # 3. camera, wall map, head, perspective, variant. LOOK at work/measure.jpg
edit the CLIP block (PRINT_TEXT/FRAME, HERO always); re-run measure to see the block
run scene.py still SAFE=1      # 5. six key frames -> work/stills/sheet1.jpg
run scene.py bake      # 6. assets/fx.mp4 (all cores; about 6 to 8 s per slot second on an M-series Mac, 6 workers)
run build.py      # 7. index.html (same switches you want in the render, e.g. SFX=0)
run post.py      # 8. frame count, phone copy, work/qa/sheet.jpg from the final mp4
